kakadu-national-park-13.name: Injalak Arts
kakadu-national-park-13.bio: Kunwinjku arts centre at Gunbalanya, just outside the park, where artists paint and weave; a permit or tour is needed.
kakadu-national-park-13.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way tourism=gallery "Injalak Art Centre" (MEDIUM, one precise OSM feature)
kakadu-national-park-13.notes: Gunbalanya is in Arnhem Land, outside Kakadu. CONTRADICTS the brief: the Kakadu page says 'Permit Required to Visit' and 'tour groups by appointment', NT tourism says a permit is needed (obtainable from the centre) and suggests booking a rock art tour; no source says the arts centre can be visited without one. injalak.com hours: Mon-Sat 8:30-4:30, Sun 9:30-4 (Kakadu page says Mon-Fri 8:30-5): shown the common range. Free entry per one listing. Cost-free so no park pass.

kakadu-national-park-14.name: Nanguluwurr Art Site
kakadu-national-park-14.bio: Rock art gallery on the Nanguluwurr walk with hand stencils, fish and turtle paintings and a two-masted lugger.
kakadu-national-park-14.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Walk is 3.4 km return, ~2 hours, Grade 3. Name uses Parks Australia spelling (Nanguluwurr) instead of the draft's Nanguluwur. Pin is the gallery (walk end), 130 m from the Barrk Sandstone Walk midpoint pin.

kakadu-national-park-15.name: Koolpin Gorge
kakadu-national-park-15.bio: Gorge (Jarrangbarnmi) of waterholes and falls in the south-east, open by permit only or on guided 4WD tours.
kakadu-national-park-15.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way waterway "Koolpin Gorge" midpoint (MEDIUM; feature of the gorge itself)
kakadu-national-park-15.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Parks page: 2 km return, ~1.5 h, moderate to difficult, access by permit only (bushwalking/camping permit, apply via DCCEEW, 7 days; applications for 2027 open 1 Dec 2026; the page also says 2 km up the gorge needs no bushwalking permit: inconsistent). Permit fee not stated. Guided 4WD tours are also sold by operators. Visit hours include the tour/drive.

kakadu-national-park-16.name: Motor Car Falls
kakadu-national-park-16.bio: Waterfall and pool at the end of a 7.5 km return walk along an old track through the Yurmikmik hills.
kakadu-national-park-16.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node waterway=waterfall "Yurmikmik (Motor Car) Falls" (MEDIUM). Trail OSM midpoint is -13.522057,132.466168 (way 254765871)
kakadu-national-park-16.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Category changed from hike to nature and pinned on the falls (a falls, not a route). Parks page: 7.5 km return, Grade 3, no time given (3-4 h is an estimate); described as a wet-season experience, and a permit is needed to bushwalk or camp in the area. A 2025 notice closed the car park for upgrades (check access report).

kakadu-national-park-17.name: Bardedjilidji Walk
kakadu-national-park-17.bio: Easy 2.5 km loop through sandstone outliers by the East Alligator River, with a rock shelter and grinding holes.
kakadu-national-park-17.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way highway=path "Bardedjilidji Walk" (id 25908697) midpoint (MEDIUM); official trailhead -12.432625,132.969782
kakadu-national-park-17.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Parks page: 2.5 km loop, ~2 h, Grade 2, 'See it: May to December'. Starts at a small car park 500 m from the upstream boat ramp (East Alligator region); check access report.

kakadu-national-park-18.name: Mirrai Lookout
kakadu-national-park-18.bio: Short, steep 2 km return climb near Nourlangie to a lookout; start early on hot days.
kakadu-national-park-18.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node tourism=viewpoint "Mirrai Lookout" (MEDIUM); Parks page trailhead -12.862407,132.710706 is ~700 m away
kakadu-national-park-18.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Draft said 3.6 km return near Bowali: wrong. Parks Australia: 2 km return, ~1.5 h, Grade 3, Burrungkuy (Nourlangie) region. Parks spells it Mirray Lookout; kept Mirrai (also the OSM spelling) so ids/search match the draft; owner may prefer Mirray.

kakadu-national-park-19.name: Barrk Sandstone Walk
kakadu-national-park-19.bio: Difficult 12 km loop through sandstone country near Nourlangie; allow about six hours and start early.
kakadu-national-park-19.hours: Daylight hours; access January to October
kakadu-national-park-19.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way highway=footway "Barrk Sandstone Walk" (id 174406038, 9.0 km mapped) midpoint (MEDIUM)
kakadu-national-park-19.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Parks page: 12 km loop, ~6 h, difficult, access listed January to October; the page shows conflicting messages (open, and closed at the request of Traditional Owners): check the access report. Walk begins/ends near Burrungkuy; pin is mid-route, 130 m from Nanguluwurr Art Site.

kakadu-national-park-20.name: Home Billabong
kakadu-national-park-20.bio: Billabong behind Cooinda with a boardwalk and viewing platform, popular for barramundi; crocodiles may be present.
kakadu-national-park-20.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way natural=water "Home Billabong" centre (MEDIUM; a water polygon centre, not the platform)
kakadu-national-park-20.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Draft '1.8 km return walk, best July to November' could not be sourced: Parks page only describes a fishing spot with boat ramp, open all year, 'crocodiles may be present'; the boardwalk and viewing platform come from NT tourism's Cooinda page (dry season, once water recedes). Walk length unverified. Route to Mardukal Billabong is closed (salvinia).

kakadu-national-park-21.name: Kungarre Walk
kakadu-national-park-21.bio: Easy 3.6 km loop at South Alligator, with a shorter 1.4 km return walk to the boardwalk.
kakadu-national-park-21.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Parks page: 3.6 km loop (~2 h) or 1.4 km return to the boardwalk, Grade 2, toilets. Draft 'monsoon forest to a billabong with birdlife' not on the page, dropped.

kakadu-national-park-22.name: Kubara Pools
kakadu-national-park-22.bio: Six-kilometre return walk from Burrungkuy through savanna woodland and sandstone to monsoon forest pools; allow four hours.
kakadu-national-park-22.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way highway=track "Kubara Pools Walk" (id 1244523541, 3.0 km one way) midpoint (MEDIUM); Parks start point -12.837073,132.858369
kakadu-national-park-22.notes: Cost is the standard adult Kakadu park pass ($40 for 7 days, per Parks Australia; reduced to $25 for 1 Jul-31 Oct 2026). Renamed from Gubara Pools to the Parks Australia spelling Kubara; id unchanged. Parks: 6 km return, ~4 h, Grade 3, open most of the year (most popular in the wet). Draft said 'with a swim': NT tourism says swimming is not permitted because of crocodiles, so the bio does not claim it.

kakadu-national-park-23.name: Jabiru
kakadu-national-park-23.bio: Kakadu's main service town, with shops, fuel, a swimming pool and accommodation, and the base for Ubirr and Nourlangie.
kakadu-national-park-23.notes: No single steward, so no ticketUrl. Wikivoyage text predates 2022 (Jabiru was handed back to Traditional Owners; services have changed): confirm shops/pool. Pin is the OSM town point, ~2 km from Bowali Visitor Centre (-12.67548,132.817155).

arnhem-land-1.name: Nhulunbuy
arnhem-land-1.bio: Gove Peninsula's main town, with shops, a bank and a library, and the base for the beaches and Yirrkala.
arnhem-land-1.notes: No ticketUrl (a town). Flying in and staying in town needs no permit; permits apply to recreation areas and to driving the Central Arnhem Road. Pin is ~0.9 km from the destination point.

arnhem-land-2.name: Buku-Larrnggay Mulka Centre
arnhem-land-2.bio: Art centre and museum at Yirrkala with Yolngu bark paintings, carvings and the original church panels.
arnhem-land-2.hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, Sat 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
arnhem-land-2.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing and Wikipedia article coordinates agree within 10 m (HIGH, two sources)
arnhem-land-2.notes: Hours and free entry from the NT tourism listing (Saturday hours only there; other listings give Mon-Fri 8-4:30): unverified. Site loaded (title names the centre) but lists no hours. closedDays Sunday.

arnhem-land-3.name: Galuru (East Woody Beach)
arnhem-land-3.bio: Beach of white sand and rust-red cliffs 3 km from Nhulunbuy, for sunset strolls and the sandspit walk to East Woody Island.
arnhem-land-3.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way highway=unclassified "East Woody Point" (end of the access road at the beach); OSM has no beach feature (LOW)
arnhem-land-3.notes: pin: LOW. Visitor Access Permit required (Dhimurru: Gaaluru/East Woody, day use only, 2WD). Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day, $80 multi-day, teen half price, under 13 free (Nov 2025 flyer, includes fees); sold at book.dhimurru.com.au. No Wikipedia article for the beach, so no wiki title.

arnhem-land-4.name: Dhamitjinya (East Woody Island)
arnhem-land-4.bio: Island reached by walking the sandspit from East Woody Beach, with 360-degree views of the coastline.
arnhem-land-4.coordinates_source: Wikipedia article coordinates (island itself; LOW, single source, no OSM island feature found)
arnhem-land-4.notes: pin: LOW (island point from Wikipedia only, 600 m from the beach pin). Sandspit crossing depends on the tide (hours qualifier is an inference from 'walk the sandspit': unverified). Reached from East Woody Beach, so the same Dhimurru permit applies. Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day, $80 multi-day, teen half price, under 13 free (Nov 2025 flyer, includes fees); sold at book.dhimurru.com.au.

arnhem-land-5.name: Wirrwawuy (Cape Wirrawoi)
arnhem-land-5.bio: Sand dunes at Cape Wirrawoi a few kilometres from town, popular for sunrise and sunset photographs.
arnhem-land-5.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node amenity=parking "Cape Wirrawuy Car Park" (MEDIUM)
arnhem-land-5.notes: Name given as Wirrwawuy (Cape Wirrawoi) to match the local-name convention used by the sibling spots. NT tourism: 5 km from town; Dhimurru lists Wirrwawuy 3 km, day use only, permit required. No Wikipedia article for the cape (draft wiki dropped). Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day, $80 multi-day, teen half price, under 13 free (Nov 2025 flyer, includes fees); sold at book.dhimurru.com.au.

arnhem-land-6.name: Garanhan (Macassan Beach)
arnhem-land-6.bio: Beach about 35 minutes from Nhulunbuy with Yolngu stone pictures of the Macassan trepang trade and picnic tables.
arnhem-land-6.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node place=locality "Macassan Beach" (MEDIUM; named locality at the beach)
arnhem-land-6.notes: Dhimurru day-use and camping area (camping needs an extra permit). Facilities per NT tourism: picnic tables, fire pits, composting toilets. Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day, $80 multi-day, teen half price, under 13 free (Nov 2025 flyer, includes fees); sold at book.dhimurru.com.au.

arnhem-land-7.name: Banambarrna (Rainbow Cliffs)
arnhem-land-7.bio: Sheer 40 m laterite cliffs near Gove Airport, viewed from the beach below; the top is a sacred site.
arnhem-land-7.notes: Dhimurru day-use and camping area. Do not stand on top (sacred). Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day, $80 multi-day, teen half price, under 13 free (Nov 2025 flyer, includes fees); sold at book.dhimurru.com.au.

arnhem-land-8.name: Bremer Island
arnhem-land-8.bio: Beach island 45 minutes by fast boat from Nhulunbuy, visited on day trips with snorkelling and kayaks.
arnhem-land-8.hours: Day trips Wednesday to Sunday, April to October
arnhem-land-8.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node place=island "Bremer Island" (MEDIUM; island point)
arnhem-land-8.notes: Banubanu Beach Retreat day trip: about A$179 per person (Rezdy listing, ~6 h, includes transfers and island permit, lunch extra); NT tourism says from A$129: conflicting, approximate. Boat leaves Gove Boat Club ramp ~9 am, times vary with tide; schedule (Wed-Sun, Apr-Oct) from one listing: unverified. NT page gives a 15-minute flight from Gove Airport as an alternative. Operator site banubanu.com/bremer-island-day-tours returned 404 and the Rezdy page 403 to scripts.

garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.name: Garig Gunak Barlu National Park
garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.bio: Remote Cobourg Peninsula park of beaches, islands and reefs, reached by air, sea or a dry-season 4WD track with a permit.
garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.hours: Dry season only, roughly May to October
garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way amenity=ranger_station "Black Point Ranger Station" (MEDIUM; visitors must check in here)
garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.notes: Park permit required; $232.10 per vehicle covers camping and transit through Arnhem Land for up to 5 adults for 7 nights (NT Government permits page via search snippet; Lonely Planet agrees on the total; the transit/camping split differs between sources). Pay at least 6 weeks ahead; Permits office 08 8999 4814. Fuel not sold in the park. Black Point Cultural Centre is on the owner's review list, not added (its pin is 25 m away). Standalone fields country/countryCode/continent/timezone included. Visit hours express a multi-day trip.

destination.name: Arnhem Land
destination.tagline: Beaches, laterite cliffs and Yolngu art on the Gove Peninsula in north-east Arnhem Land.
destination.description: The Gove Peninsula sits at the north-eastern corner of Arnhem Land, about 600 km from Darwin on Yolngu country. Nhulunbuy is the base for white-sand beaches, rust-red cliffs and a sandspit walk to East Woody Island, while Yirrkala, 19 km away, is home to the Buku-Larrnggay Mulka art centre and museum. Bremer Island lies offshore for day trips by boat. Most of the land is Aboriginal-owned, so visits to its recreation areas need a permit.
whyVisit: See Yolngu bark paintings at Yirrkala
Walk the sandspit to East Woody Island

goodToKnow.title: Dhimurru permit needed
goodToKnow.detail: East Woody, Cape Wirrawoi, Rainbow Cliffs and Macassan Beach need a Dhimurru Visitor Access Permit: $30 per adult for a day.

goodToKnow.title: Fly in or drive
goodToKnow.detail: Airnorth flies from Darwin to Gove. The Central Arnhem Road is unsealed, a dry-season route, and needs a separate transit permit.

goodToKnow.title: Boat trips follow the tides
goodToKnow.detail: Bremer Island day trips leave Nhulunbuy at tide-dependent times; one operator runs them Wednesday to Sunday, April to October.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The Dry season, {months}, brings sunny days and cooler nights and opens the Central Arnhem Road; the Wet, November to April, means storms and cyclone risk.

destinations.notes: Placement order changed to importance: Buku-Larrnggay Mulka (3 counted sources, the cultural headline), Nhulunbuy (base), Rainbow Cliffs, East Woody Beach, Macassan Beach, Bremer Island, East Woody Island, Cape Wirrawoi. Photos not done. Best months from NT tourism (Dry May-Oct) and Nhulunbuy climate guides.
